My soul is sad and much dismayed
My soul is sad and much dismayed;
See, LORD, what legions of my foes,

No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Cowper printed the hymn under Ephesians 6:16. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
